race.comment: MR MILLER (3) displayed plenty of ability in his maiden preparation and is a big watch in his return. Has trialled well under McDonald and no surprise to see him booked first up. Expected to go on to bigger things this time in and looks a cut above. Stablemate PHANTOM MAJOR (6) is no slouch though, having won well at Canterbury last start. Up in grade, but also has good talent and shapes as the main danger. IT'S A WONDER (9) went better than it appears on paper first up and is big odds for a mare of her talent. MAZIS (1) will be better over further but wouldn't be surprised to see him sprint well fresh, while SOCIABLE (7) continues to race well and appears the next in line.
